info.title: DocSecWin
info.description: See API.md and BACKEND.md for byte-preserving storage, metadata selector semantics, and backend-only routing. Client-Identifier gathering triggers store peer information locally and return HTTP status only (empty body on success and error). Separate authenticated unmarked requests retrieve local information; see BACKEND.md.

get.summary: List/select metadata; sort timestamp descending for reverse chronology

200.description: Success; when a gathering marker is present, information is saved locally and this response has an empty body (Content-Length: 0).

parameters.name: Client-Identifier
parameters.description: pretend-to-be-client:<configured hostname/IPv4/IPv6[:port]> triggers local gathering. No fetched content or listing is returned. Success: 200 with empty body. Errors: HTTP error status with empty body. Requires separate local and source credentials.

parameters.name: X-DocSec-Source-Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer REMOTE_TOKEN; required when the gathering marker is present.
